orientation_convention:
**Portrait stick, component face toward the user, USB end down.** Long axis (v, 63.897 mm) vertical; width axis (u, 25.86 mm) horizontal.
- **Bottom end (functional anchor) = v-max edge (v=63.897):** hosts both USB-C receptacles; cables mate horizontally, plug axis parallel to the long axis, inserting upward-into / cable-exiting downward-from the bottom wall; shells 3.3 mm tall on the front face, front faces inset 0.648 mm from the board edge [citation: component_geometry.json J1/J2; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "UART"/"USB"]. This continues the family convention established for the old rev [citation: easyduino-esp32-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json].
- **Top end = v-min edge (v=0):** ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module with its PCB antenna at the board edge — RF keep-out zone: no metal above or behind the top end; the prior rev solved this with a plastic locator rim at v=0 [citation: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1.kicad_mod "Antenna Area" + U1 rot-0 placement in Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb; lessons.md #11; easyduino-esp32-enclosure/README.md].
- **Front face (what the user sees) = F.Cu component face**, origin of all part heights; silkscreen (board name `Easyduino ESP32S3` at u≈16.5, v≈44–45; all pin labels) reads normally in this orientation [citation: Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text scan, F.SilkS rot 0]. Back face = solder side, faces away from the user.
- **User-left = u-min side** (u→0): pin column EN, 3V3, 4…14, 5V, GND (`EN` silk u=2.31 v=7.52) [citation: Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb]. **User-right = u-max side** (u→25.86): GND, 43, 44, 1, 2, 42…19 (`43` silk u=25.04 v=4.98). Both long edges carry breadboard pin rails spanning v≈0.1–55.4 (DevKitC-pattern helper footprint U2) [citation: component_geometry.json U2; top-level README.md replication claim].
- **What the user sees, top to bottom:** WROOM-1 module + antenna (top), Q1/Q2 and the RST/BOOT button pair at mid-height v≈33.5–35.5, AMS1117 regulator (U5, v≈37.3–43.4) beside the board-name silk, then CP2102 (v≈45.6–51.3), LEDs, and the two USB-C ports at the bottom end [citation: component_geometry.json U1/Q1/Q2/SW1/SW2/U5/U3; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb silk labels].
- Dual-port roles: **J1 = "UART"** (CP2102 USB-serial, programming port), bottom-left; **J2 = "USB"** (native ESP32-S3 USB), bottom-right; only one power input at a time [citation: Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "UART"/"USB"; ESP32S3/readme.md §Specs "5V (USB UART OR USB ESP32)"].
user_facing_features:
Mapped through the convention (board-local u/v → user space; front face toward user, USB end down, u-min = user-left):
1. **USB-C "UART" window (J1)** — bottom wall, user-left half: u[1.155, 10.795] (center u=5.975, width 9.64 mm), shell h=3.3 above the front face, mating along +v through the v=63.897 wall [citation: component_geometry.json J1; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "UART" u=4.90 v=55.95].
2. **USB-C "USB" window (J2)** — bottom wall, user-right half: u[15.025, 24.665] (center u=19.845, width 9.64 mm), same height/mating axis [citation: component_geometry.json J2; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "USB" u=18.75 v=56.03]. The pair is near-symmetric about u=12.93 (centers ±6.9 mm); plan seated-plug + cable-bend envelopes per old-rev precedent [citation: easyduino-esp32-enclosure/README.md].
3. **RST button (SW1)** — mid-height, user-left: u[6.695, 11.695] × v[33.549, 35.549], 2.0 mm tall; lid-side (front-face) access if opened — NOT at the USB end, contradicting the old-rev orient note [citation: component_geometry.json SW1; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "RST" u=6.70 v=32.98; easyduino-esp32-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json].
4. **BOOT button (SW2)** — mid-height, user-right: u[14.295, 19.295] × v[33.549, 35.549], 2.0 mm tall [citation: component_geometry.json SW2; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "BOOT" u=22.30 v=32.95]. Old rev kept both buttons under the lid; keep-or-open is an envelope-stage decision [citation: easyduino-esp32-enclosure/stages/02-orient.json].
5. **PWR LED (D1)** — bottom-center on the front face, between the two ports: u[13.175, 13.815] × v[54.579, 56.139], 0.8 mm; a status window here would sit just above the bottom wall, left of the USB port [citation: component_geometry.json D1; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "PWR" u=11.59 v=54.05].
6. **Second LED (D4, likely GPIO38 activity)** — lower-right quadrant of the front face: u[17.8, 19.36] × v[47.03, 47.67]; function unverified (nearby silk "GPIO38" at u=20.59 v=48.95 is the only hint) — treat label as unproven before cutting a window [citation: component_geometry.json D4; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb gr_text "GPIO38"].
7. **Breadboard pin rails (U2)** — both long side edges, u≈1–2 and u≈24–25, v≈0.1–55.4: user-left and user-right walls; if the case must allow breadboard use these need side reliefs, otherwise they stay internal [citation: component_geometry.json U2; Easyduino_ESP32S3.kicad_pcb pin-label columns].
8. **Antenna keep-out (non-opening feature)** — top end: no metal (screw bosses, brackets) above or within the v<~2 zone centered u≈13 on the front face; use a plastic rim there as in the prior rev [citation: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1.kicad_mod; lessons.md #11; easyduino-esp32-enclosure/README.md].
